answer: Each identity posts a 30,000 POA bond to the mesa registry and locks it 14 days. Three established non-kin peers co-sign the ledger history before it earns attestation credit. If a sybil twin appears, the registry slashes the full bond into the oasis pool and marks every address that co-signed it. The ledge holds the bond through the lock, so a farm of 500 fake identities burns 15 million POA it cannot touch for two weeks. It is a car deposit the lot keeps until the keys come back.
